r6r1_bounded_poll_preserved.evidence: The loop uses monotonic start/deadline, max_wait clamped to 2.0 seconds, and poll_interval clamped to 0.1 seconds; configured constant is 0.05 seconds (lines 216-280). However, the runner call has no subprocess timeout (lines 244-247), so a hung ausearch can exceed the claimed maximum wait before the deadline is checked.

exact_key_required.evidence: Audit keys are restricted by the exact token regex and exact-token matching is required before PASS (lines 230, 253-267).

exact_path_required.evidence: _exact_file() rejects non-absolute, wildcard, directory, and slash-terminated paths; polling requires the exact watched path (lines 73-83, 229, 253-267).

parseable_raw_serial_required.evidence: parse_audit_serial() accepts only msg=audit(<numeric epoch>[.<fraction>]:<integer>) raw syntax (line 204).

micro_probe_verdict_pass_required.evidence: A parsed serial plus exact key/path is converted to an audit permission-filter event and must satisfy micro_probe_verdict() == PASS (lines 255-267).

fail_closed_timeout.evidence: A normal no-evidence response returns BLOCKED and _default_micro_probe records AUDIT_EVIDENCE_MISSING (lines 277-288, 364-370, 1791-1801), but the absent runner timeout means a hung ausearch is not fail-closed at 2.0 seconds.

exact_inverse_audit_rule_cleanup.evidence: delete_rule_from_add() changes only -a to -d for the exact path+perm=rw+pid rule, and production removals execute in finally (lines 85-108, 1665-1671).

temporary_probe_file_cleanup.evidence: The temporary probe path is unlinked in the probe finally block (lines 380-388).

baseline_restoration.evidence: Probe cleanup rechecks the clean baseline and production post-cleanup requires the historical empty-rule hash and no canonical rules (lines 390-404, 1690-1712).

audit_rule_scope_unchanged.evidence: The rule builder remains exact path + perm=rw + live pid + random key; tests reject wildcards and assert no -S/all broad rule. No system-wide read/write rule is introduced.

micro_probe_evidence_integrity.evidence: Lines 255-267 synthesize an AUDIT_FILESYSTEM_PERMISSION_FILTER/FILE_READ_OR_WRITE event from a parseable serial plus key/path text. The raw record type, syscall, requested access, permission-filter provenance, and same-record key/path association are not parsed or validated, permitting a false PASS from unrelated text.

downstream_real_r5_derived_mininet_smoke.evidence: The privileged gate calls _reviewed_mininet_smoke(), which invokes _run_reviewed_mininet_smoke(); the real Mininet topology remains after the probe gate (lines 1497-1505, 1774-1813).

independent_negative_recomputation.observation: The current poller accepted a parseable serial and matching key/path even though the fixture supplied no permission-filter event semantics.

review_findings.title: ausearch invocation is not time-bounded
review_findings.impact: The 2.0-second evidence wait is only checked after runner() returns; a hung /usr/sbin/ausearch can stall the privileged path beyond the required maximum.

review_findings.title: PASS gate fabricates audit semantics from weak text predicates
review_findings.impact: A serial plus key/path text is promoted to an audit-backed file-access event without validating raw event identity, syscall/permission semantics, or same-record linkage.

review_findings.title: Interpreted-mode regression fixture does not assert its mock argv
review_findings.impact: The fixture still directly recomputes the interpreted parser failure, but it does not independently assert that the historical immediate lookup used -i.

non_blocking_observation: The polling function computes exact key/path predicates once for accumulated diagnostics and again for the PASS condition (lines 253-267). This is a small duplication heuristic, not a behavioral or specification failure.
historical_evidence_boundary: The R6R1/R6R2 contracts were consulted for non-regression vocabulary; every PASS above is based on current committed source, current tests, or the fresh static self-check.
